 what we offer 
 A gross hourly wage of € 15.29 
 Internal SAP system training and education 
 Travel allowance from 10 km at € 0.23 per km

 who you are

You will join the well-known international company Hans Anders. There is a fantastic atmosphere on the shop floor with a friendly group of colleagues and an informal culture.
